title: PREL external projection registry
description: A registry of human-readable projections of Git-resident subjects into external documents. A projection entry names its external id, the revision that was observed, the digest of the export that was observed, the exact Git subjects it projects, the backlinks that let a reader return to those subjects, and the state of the read-back that compared the two. A projection is never implementation, completion, product-truth, merge or release authority: it is a rendering of a subject whose authority stays with the subject. Refusal class C08 is the named failure when a registry entry is used as machine authority; C01 is the named failure when a projected subject is a mutable alias rather than an exact object.

path.description: Repository-relative path. An absolute or machine-local path is refusal class C10.

commit.description: Exact commit. A branch name, tag, main or latest is refusal class C01.

external_id.description: Opaque external identifier. It carries no credential and no access grant; possession of the id is not possession of the document.

observed_revision.description: The revision identifier of the external object at the moment it was read. A projection with no observed revision cannot be compared to anything later.

export_digest.description: sha256 of the exported bytes that were actually observed, not of the document the reader believes exists.

backlinks.description: How a reader of the projection returns to the canonical subject. A projection with no backlink becomes a second source of truth the moment it is copied.

read_back.description: NOT_EXERCISED means nobody re-read the projection; ABSENT means the projection could not be read at all. The two are different queues and are not interchangeable.
